statement: Sort the files in ~/sutra-demo/sort-me into subfolders named for each file's extension (a.pdf into pdf/, b.jpg into jpg/, c.txt into txt/, d.csv into csv/), with a test, and run it on that folder.
audience: The Requester, who wants the files in ~/sutra-demo/sort-me sorted by extension
may_touch: the subfolders named for each file's extension (pdf/, jpg/, txt/, csv/)
done_when: sort_files.py sorts the files in a given folder into subfolders named for each file's extension (a.pdf into pdf/, b.jpg into jpg/, c.txt into txt/, d.csv into csv/).
test_sort_files.py is an automated test that checks sort_files.py puts a.pdf in pdf/, b.jpg in jpg/, c.txt in txt/ and d.csv in csv/, and passes.
Run on ~/sutra-demo/sort-me, the script leaves a.pdf in pdf/, b.jpg in jpg/, c.txt in txt/ and d.csv in csv/.
